$comment: Template of machine-specific paths. Copy to bookwriter-project.local.json, fill in real absolute paths for your machine, keep it gitignored. Never hardcode machine paths in project files: reference them by these keys (resolve with: node tools/resolve.mjs <key>).
corpus: <absolute path to the documentation corpus folder (formerly 'documentation official') on this machine>
gdrive: <absolute path to the bookwriter-google folder on this machine's Google Drive>
archive: <absolute path to the bookwriter-old archive folder on this machine>

external.svelte: <absolute path to local Svelte 5 source repository>
external.svelteDev2026: <absolute path to local SvelteKit dev repository>
